description: This PHP class defines a data model 'WorkShiftModel' used for serialization and normalization of WorkShift entities within the OrangeHRM Admin API. It specifies schema properties such as id, name, hoursPerDay, startTime, and endTime, and includes configuration for attribute filtering and naming.

classes.name: WorkShiftModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing WorkShift entities for API responses in the OrangeHRM system.
